records.name: reset
records.semantics: zero the whole 0x30-byte state, then v1 = seed+P1+P2, v2 = seed+P2, v3 = seed, v4 = seed-P1; returns 0

records.name: update
records.contract: update(state: *mut XXH32_state_t, data: *const u8, n: usize) -> 0
records.semantics: buffer sub-16-byte remainders in mem, process full 16-byte stripes with one round per lane, keep memsize == total_len % 16; returns 0

records.name: digest
records.semantics: merge the lanes (or seed+P5+total_len when large_len is clear), run the 4/1-byte tail over mem, avalanche; returns the u32 hash
